name: azure-devops-tasks
title: AZ Work Items
description: View and update your assigned Azure DevOps work items
author: stoumann

commands.name: my-work-items
commands.title: My Work Items
commands.description: Browse your assigned work items and change their state

preferences.name: organization
preferences.title: Organization
preferences.description: Your Azure DevOps organization (e.g. 'software-central' from dev.azure.com/software-central)

preferences.name: project
preferences.title: Default Project
preferences.description: Optional: filter to a specific project. Leave empty to see items from all projects.

preferences.name: email
preferences.title: Your Email
preferences.description: The email address used in Azure DevOps (used to filter @Me)

preferences.name: pat
preferences.title: Personal Access Token
preferences.description: Create at https://dev.azure.com/{org}/_usersSettings/tokens with scopes: Work Items (Read & Write)

preferences.name: states
preferences.title: States to Show
preferences.description: Comma-separated states to include. Leave empty to show all states except Closed, Removed and Done.

preferences.name: types
preferences.title: Types to Show
preferences.description: Comma-separated work item types to include. Leave empty to show all types.
